notes.content: Comparative international studies majors are required to complete a minor in a foreign language. The minor in a foreign language in one of the two world regions identified as a primary or secondary area of focus will fulfill the foreign language requirement for the major. (Contact minor adviser about the benefits of taking an ACTFL foreign language oral proficiency test.)

notes.content: The online catalog ( http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/catalog/index.html ) identifies which region the courses listed in the additional major requirements will apply to. You will choose 3 units from your primary focus region and 3 units from your secondary focus region.
